Oral Judgment

1. This appeal is filed by the claimant against the Judgment and award dated 20.09.2019 passed in MVC No.618/2017 by the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC and MACT, Aurad-B, (for short 'the tribunal') seeking enhancement of the compensation.
2. The claimant filed claim petition seeking compensation of Rs.2,00,000/-.
The tribunal awarded a sum of Rs.45,000/- with interest at the rate of 8% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.
Aggrieved by the said order, the present appeal is preferred.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:6551 HC-KAR 3.
During the pendency of the appeal, it is observed that, P.W.2 is shown as Doctor, but he is not a Doctor.
He is eyewitness to the occurrence of the accident.
So the Doctor has not been examined to assess the disability.
Hence, requested this Court to remand the matter to the tribunal to examine the Doctor for assessing the disability.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent-insurance company submits his no objection for remand of the matter to the tribunal.

5. In view of the above, the matter is remanded to the tribunal with a specific direction to provide opportunity to both sides to lead evidence and to advance arguments and the tribunal is directed to Sharanappa S/O Pandit vs Hanmanth S/O Mahadappa Mikre And Anr on 5 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131620102/
